profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Fullstack Javascript Developer with background in Technical Recruiting, Office Administration, Intellectual Property, Podcasting, DJ'ing, and assorted other loose scraps.  Enthusiastic communicator, adept at synthesizing technical challenges for a non-technical audience, and quick learner.

Projects Include:
* monitoring platform for one of the largest pile driving companies in the world (ekal.nl) [NL]
* geolocation-based tracking platform for private vehicle fleets (tracktrace.net) [NL]
* clinical trial identification platform in the pharma space (acceletrial.com) [USA]
* patient interface for a billion-dollar chain of hospitals (askapollo.com) [IN]

Expertise:
* Full-stack javascript development (3+ years experience, remote and in-person)
* Git, native Javascript, ES6, React, node, ajax, docker, webpack, NoSQL (RethinkDB, Mongo), PostgreSQL, Cypress

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* NodeJS/React base tech stack
* Supplementary tech including: Webpack, Google Maps API, Socket Servers, NoSQL and SQL databases
* Leading client meetings to develop and refinenew features
* Remote collaboration on small-team development projects

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
* Helping to build and maintain full-stack ReactJS client interface
* Writing back-end javascript to modify records queried from a cloud database
* Modifying legacy code to accept data of evolving structures and sizes
* Participating in remote meetings where technical updates are synthesized for our clients
* Producing .csv records via SQL queries for non-technical client departments

positions.title: Principal
positions.description: •	Run executive search queries to fill vacant, high-level positions in New York's competitive tech startup industry

positions.title: Assistant Mailroom Manager
positions.description:
•	Assist in the day-to-day management of mail processing and delivery for our client
•	Compose detailed process sheets that break down the individual components of specialized tasks
•	Delegate responsibilities amongst our five-man team, ensuring timely and accurate completion of tasks for the client
•	Represent Océ in a surrogate role, maintaining and facilitating a functional working relationship with the client
•	Encouraging the client to try other services that we offer through our outsourced business service packages

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
• Collating incoming and outgoing documents of a sensitive nature, related to the unique components of specific insurance policies
• Sorting and delivered interoffice and incoming mail
• Utilizing FedEx, UPS, and USPS to ensure efficient and timely transport of a high volume of outgoing mail
• Routing incoming phone calls to specific departments within the company
• Operating copy and scanning equipment
